An '''unidentified regent''' was appointed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. [[Gender/Legends|He or she]] served as acting [[Viceroy/Legends|viceroy]] in the absence of [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Prestor Organa]], who had been forced to abandon his function to become [[Senator/Legends|senator]] of the [[Alderaan sector/Legends|Alderaan sector]].<ref name="FF67" /> When Organa retired from the [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial Senate]] in [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], he returned to his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of Alderaan and reclaimed his title.<ref name="Databank">{{DB|character|bailorgana|Organa, Bail}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The fact that Bail Organa transferred his functions to a regent was only mentioned in the [[The Official Star Wars Fact File 67|67th issue]] of ''[[The Official Star Wars Fact File]]''.<ref name="FF67" /> Nonetheless, the the now defunct [[Databank (original)|Databank]] of [[StarWars.com]] stated that Organa had to reclaim his title when he retired from the Senate, which implies he had abandoned it earlier.<ref name="Databank" /> A "[[Regent of Alderaan]]" was also mentioned in the [[1993]] roleplaying guide ''[[Han Solo and the Corporate Sector Sourcebook]]''.<ref name="HSCSSB">''[[Han Solo and the Corporate Sector Sourcebook]]''</ref>
